card.name: Commas and linking words before trial descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a description of a clinical trial or study, such as after 'two large' or 'In' at the start of a sentence about a cohort. Also the separator after 'Official Title:' in a trial record.

modes.label: Comma after large
modes.description: A comma following 'a large' or 'two large' and before words like randomized or controlled trial.
modes.example: In a large<<,>> randomized, postmarketing safety study in rhe

modes.description: The word 'In' opening a sentence that goes on to describe the same cohort or study.
